meta.crs_output: EPSG:4326 (WGS84), 6 decimal places; BNG to WGS84 through the OS OSTN15 grid (lib.mjs bngProjector); rounded to 5 decimals by a hand rule; vertices closer than 1 m to the previous kept vertex dropped by a hand rule
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run 29jwj: resources chosen by the written rules (harvest-log.json meta.rules: formats, dedupe, caps); every feature read (GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile, or table rows with coordinate columns as points, the CRS judged per row by value); a feature is kept when it meets the zone (the 3D model box, BNG E 532400-539900, N 176700-182300): a vertex inside, an edge crossing or the box inside a polygon; whole geometries kept, whole_in_zone and in_cw added; WGS84 6 decimals through OSTN15; contact fields dropped.
selection_notes: hand rule: the 2011 output area outlines only, generalised and clipped to the coastline (BGC; the full-resolution BFC and extent BFE copies repeat them) (the LSOA, MSOA and ward layers of 2011 repeat statistical-boundaries and 20od9); 5 decimals
2011_london_boundaries.zip: 67560 features of layers /^(?!OA_2011_BGC)/i left out (hand rule)
